Data:A affair apollomarsyas.json.label: The Affair of 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:A affair apollomarsyas.json.descriptionunlocked: An upcoming production of an opera with a very ancient pedigree indeed...

Data:A affair casket.json.label: The Affair of the Messenger's Casket
Data:A affair casket.json.descriptionunlocked: In a hidden fold of the mountains above the city of Cluj lies the enigmatic relic they call Saint Mihail's Coffin...

Data:A affair clawclouds.json.label: The Affair of the Claw and the Clouds
Data:A affair clawclouds.json.descriptionunlocked: From the far monastery of St Tentreto, we hear stories of unexpected visitors - visitors from behind the sky...

Data:A affair debt.json.label: The Affair of the Forgivable Debt
Data:A affair debt.json.descriptionunlocked: Two Reckoner mobs have gone to war in the unremarkable Lithuanian city of Kaunas. Why? What's in Kaunas?

Data:A affair endeavour.json.label: The Affair of the Royal Endeavour
Data:A affair endeavour.json.descriptionunlocked: The New King has sanctioned the use of the Crown's wealth to fund a visionary new industrial project...

Data:A affair eye.json.label: The Affair of the Unfettered Eye
Data:A affair eye.json.descriptionunlocked: Messana: a prosperous little desert village that has become a place of pilgrimage. There have been peculiar manifestations there of late...

Data:A affair friend.json.label: The Affair of the Absent Friend
Data:A affair friend.json.descriptionunlocked: The Ligeian Medusa is long dead. But she walks the streets of Budapest by moonlight and, for the first time, she's being glimpsed in daylight too...

Data:A affair god.json.label: The Affair of the God in the Wood
Data:A affair god.json.descriptionunlocked: A faddish health camp has attracted attention after many of its clients seem to have developed sudden, sometimes upsetting, artistic abilities...

Data:A affair grunewald.json.label: The Affair of the Grunewald Provision
Data:A affair grunewald.json.descriptionunlocked: The assets of Grunewald's Permanent Circus were disposed of by the Bureau. In hindsight, this was a mistake...

Data:A affair guest.json.label: The Affair of the Endless Guest
Data:A affair guest.json.descriptionunlocked: An 'inhabitation of Worms' is never to be taken lightly...

Data:A affair heist.json.label: The Affair of the Oriflamme Heist
Data:A affair heist.json.descriptionunlocked: Oriflamme's Auction House is never robbed. But what if it has been?

Data:A affair horizon.json.label: The Affair of the Other Horizon
Data:A affair horizon.json.descriptionunlocked: Sailors have a term for the compass-whirl phenomenon which occurs before sightings of the city Ys...

Data:A affair lark.json.label: The Affair of the Unfinished Lark
Data:A affair lark.json.descriptionunlocked: For years a sculptor-adept laboured at his masterpiece. And now, puzzlingly and suddenly, he is dead...

Data:A affair mystique.json.label: The Affair of the Particular Mystique
Data:A affair mystique.json.descriptionunlocked: The Suppression Bureau has a growing interest in the recent fad for unconventional - often prophetic - religious movements...

Data:A affair numa.json.label: In the Mist
Data:A affair numa.json.descriptionunlocked: What happens in Numa, stays in Numa. Generally.

Data:A affair opera.json.label: The Affair of the Invisible Opera
Data:A affair opera.json.descriptionunlocked: No-one has ever successfully staged an entire performance of 'Wings Within Wings'. But now someone is trying again...

Data:A affair revolution.json.label: The Affair of the Threshold Revolution
Data:A affair revolution.json.descriptionunlocked: The Légion du Seuil recruits from among the Bounds-beasts. How trustworthy is it, really?

Data:A affair rose.json.label: The Affair of the Dappled Rose
Data:A affair rose.json.descriptionunlocked: Another man has died in the desert. He raved to the end about gardens, with a flower crushed in his hand...

Data:A affair saint.json.label: The Affair of the Sandalwood Saint
Data:A affair saint.json.descriptionunlocked: An odd little image in a church in Strasbourg has become a locus for wild claims of healing and haunting. When it comes to the attention of the Church hierarchy, they'll rule it miraculous or heretical... unless someone takes a hand before then.

Data:A affair skin.json.label: The Affair of the Second Skin
Data:A affair skin.json.descriptionunlocked: The labhite Abecassis has begun a dramatic and dangerous metamorphosis...

Data:A affair tapestry.json.label: The Affair of the Friar's Tapestry
Data:A affair tapestry.json.descriptionunlocked: A tapestry has been stolen from the Haustorium that depicts details of a very old rite indeed...
